Title: Signed-in user lands on the dashboard
Preconditions: User has signed in with Microsoft SSO
Expected Result: The Dashboard heading and the Operational Analytics section are visible

Title: Sidebar navigates to Production Orders
Preconditions: User is signed in on the dashboard
Expected Result: The URL is /productionOrders and the 'All Production Orders' heading and orders table are visible

Title: Production Orders table shows the expected columns
Expected Result: The table shows columns Production Order, Breaker Type, Control Voltage, Current Rating, Customer, Created By, Status

Title: Look Up button is disabled until an order number is entered
Steps:
1. Open the Lookup page
2. Observe the Look Up button
3. Enter a 7-digit production order number
Expected Result: The Look Up button is disabled while the field is empty and becomes enabled after a 7-digit number is entered
